name: Snow removal (seasonal route)
summary: Seasonal and per-push snow plowing priced per stop from plow, shovel and salt time, truck cost and expected storms.

items.label: Plow + shovel + salt a two-car driveway (per push)
items.source: 8 two-car driveways x 10 expected snow events x 1 pass (index.html STARTING_SITES and defaults); 12 plow + 8 sidewalk + 6 deadhead min = 26 min; 1.5 salt bags at $8 = $12 + truck/plow $45/h x 0.4333 h = $19.50 (SITE_PRESETS in calc.mjs)

items.label: Ice / salt-only visit, two-car driveway
items.source: 8 driveways x 6 expected ice events; (12 + 8) min x ICE_MINUTE_FACTOR 0.65 + 6 deadhead = 19 min; 1.5 bags x ICE_SALT_FACTOR 1.2 x $8 = $14.40 + truck $45/h x 0.3167 h = $14.25

specialistModels: Seasonal contract vs per-push pricing, expected snow and ice events, passes per storm, break-even storm count for a seasonal price, and truck cost per hour folded in here as material.
